title: QUIC Major Peer Interop Matrix Work Item
summary: Add an advisory manual hosted profile that runs the currently executable major non-HTTP/3 interop scenarios against quic-go and msquic with Incursa.Quic in both local client and local server roles.
planned_changes:
- Add a `major-peer-matrix` choice to the manual interop-runner workflow.
- Add matrix cells for local client and local server roles against `quic-go` and `msquic` for `handshake`, `retry`, `transfer`, `keyupdate`, and `resumption`.
- Pre-pull the selected peer image for each matrix cell and upload a distinct per-cell artifact bundle with `if: always()`.
- Keep blocked or out-of-scope cells out of the major peer matrix.
- Expand helper-side FileNotFound advisory classification for keyupdate and resumption with testcase-specific preserved-log markers.
- Document the profile and add requirement-home tests that lock the matrix shape.
out_of_scope: running the major peer matrix on push or pull request
verification_plan: Run the focused requirement-home tests for `REQ-QUIC-INT-0017` and `REQ-QUIC-INT-0019`, run helper dry-run plans for representative quic-go and msquic client/server cells, run helper FileNotFound fallback tests for keyupdate and resumption, run SpecTrace validation where the repo baseline allows it, and dispatch the manual `major-peer-matrix` profile when hosted artifact evidence is needed.
completion_notes: Implemented the manual `major-peer-matrix` workflow profile and requirement-home tests. The configuration now covers local client and local server cells for `handshake`, `retry`, `transfer`, `keyupdate`, and `resumption` against `quic-go` and `msquic`. The helper now has testcase-specific FileNotFound advisory classification for keyupdate and resumption preserved-log evidence. Hosted execution remains an explicit advisory follow-up evidence step rather than a push or pull-request gate.
